body.intent: Fix two change sets with the same title prefix share one worktree and branch: the 'usage governor's limits are static' bug request's change set 01M6T2DC got the title 'Fix the usage governor's', the same as 01M6T1ZR, so its plan run used worktree rhiza.fix-the-usage-governor-s and branch cs/fix-the-usage-governor-s; its plan entries rode in 01M6T1ZR's PR #345, its ship state pointed at #345, and its plan run failed at rebased-green ('#345 is MERGED, not open'). A change set's worktree and branch slug must be unique (e.g. add a short ID suffix on a collision), and a run must never commit or track another change set's PR
